title: Seeing Is Not Perceiving: When Synthetic Consumers Can and Cannot Pretest Visual Marketing
abstract: arXiv:2609.25677v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Marketers now deploy generative AI agents as synthetic consumers to pretest visual assets such as logos, packaging, and advertising at a fraction of human-panel cost. However, this procedure assumes that a model seeing a visual cue can also perceive its consumer meaning, which is largely untested. We stress-test the assumption using six canonical visual marketing experiments, varying the two levers managers control: model generation (GPT-4o-mini vs. GPT-5.4-mini) and input format (plain text vs. JSON). Every resulting configuration passed the manipulation checks; however, none of the configurations reproduced more than two of the six human effects, and the remainder were nonsignificant. The one exception was a significant reversal of the human pattern. Providing conceptual or empirical evidence through in-context learning steers average responses toward the human effect. translated_title: 看见不等于感知：合成消费者何时能以及何时不能预测试视觉营销
translated_abstract: 营销人员如今部署生成式AI智能体作为“合成消费者”，以远低于人类被试小组的成本对标志、包装和广告等视觉资产进行预测试。然而，这一流程隐含着一个假设：模型“看到”视觉线索的同时也能“感知”其消费者含义，而这一假设在很大程度上未经检验。我们通过六个经典的视觉营销实验对该假设进行压力测试，改变管理者可控的两个杠杆：模型代次（GPT-4o-mini vs. GPT-5.4-mini）和输入格式（纯文本 vs. JSON）。所有配置均通过了操纵检验；然而，没有任何配置能够复现六个人类效应中的两个以上，其余效应均不显著。唯一的例外是一个与人类模式显著相反的逆转。通过上下文学习提供概念性或经验性证据可以将模型的平均反应引导向人类效应。然而，这种引导存在局限：即使引导成功，一个配置……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过六个经典视觉营销实验压力测试发现，生成式AI“合成消费者”虽能通过操纵检验，却无法可靠复现人类被试的视觉营销效应，上下文学习引导的作用也有限，警示用AI预测试视觉营销资产存在重大风险。
en_tdlr: Stress-testing six canonical visual marketing experiments reveals that synthetic AI consumers pass manipulation checks but fail to reliably reproduce human effects, with in-context learning steering offering only limited help, cautioning against relying on generative AI to pretest visual marketing assets.
